utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: The commander was Dr. Haris.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And after joining that unit, sir, in the summer of 1993, were you engaged with the El Mujahedin Unit in any combat operations?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Of course. After joining that unit, I was with them in some areas.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Focusing your attention, PW-2, on 1993 and the second half of that year, can you give us some of the locations where you engaged in combat operations as a member of the El Mujahedin Unit?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Zabilje, near Vitez, and Kruscica, near Vitez.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: These operations, sir, in Zabilje, near Vitez, and Kruscica, near Vitez, were any other military units involved in these combat operations?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I arrived in Zabilje as part of a second group sent as a form of assistance. I only saw members of the El Mujahed group there, no one else. At Kruscica, the 17th Krajina Brigade was also stationed.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: The 17th Krajina Brigade, PW-2, was a unit of what military force?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Of the Army of the BH.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recall, sir, approximately when the military operations in Kruscica took place, what time period?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: September 1993.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: PW-2, other than Dr. Haris, do you recall the names of any of the leadership of the El Mujahedin Unit at the time you joined that unit in the summer of 1993?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Vahidin and Muatez.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Your Honours, at this time, I'd ask that the witness be shown Exhibit 92, which is the photo booklet. We can do this electronically, and I would ask the witness to identify any persons that he might see in that exhibit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: May we see the exhibit, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Witness, do you see a photograph on the screen in front of you?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I do.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: I'm going to show you, sir, a series of photographs. I believe there are 22 pages. I'm going to ask you if you recognise any of the individuals depicted in these photographs; and if you do, if you can simply indicate that you recognise them, and please tell us the name or names of the persons in the photographs. Let's begin, then, with Exhibit 92, page 1. Do you recognise this person?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: This is Sheikh Enver, "rahmetulali."

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Let's go to page 2, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Yes, Madam Vidovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I'm sorry to interrupt my learned friend from the Prosecution. However, the witness said -- the witness said "Sheikh Enver," and then he said, "the deceased," whereas what was entered in the transcript may stand for something the witness did not say.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Indeed, what does that stand for, the word in brackets? Does anybody know?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The word in brackets indicates, for the benefit of the transcribers, that that's a phonetic, and they'll check that against the audiotapes. But let me try to clear this up.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: PW-2, this person you've identified as Sheikh Enver, do you know this person's last name or family name?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you know, sir, if this person that you identified as Sheikh Enver is still alive?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: He was killed.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recall, sir, approximately when he was killed and the circumstances by which he was killed?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: He was killed at Zepce by the HVO members. This was toward the end of the war, or the war may have been over by then. I don't know exactly.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recall, PW-2, the approximate month and year that Sheikh Enver was killed by the HVO at Zepce?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: In late 1995.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Okay. Sir, now before you is page 2 of Exhibit 92. Do you recognise the person depicted in these photographs?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: That's the same person.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And what do you mean, sir, by "the same person"?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Sheikh Enver, the late Sheikh Enver.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we please go to page 3 of Exhibit 92.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise this person, sir?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: This is also Sheikh Enver.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And the next page.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: That would be page 4 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise this person, PW-2?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I believe that this is the same person we saw earlier in that footage from Travnik.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The next photograph, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Actually, before we do that, do you know the name of this person?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next page, please. I believe this is page six, 6, Exhibit 92.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Is it page 6 or page 5?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Page 5.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's the same person as before, as the one we saw on the photograph just before.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If we could go to page 6 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise this person, PW-2?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: This is the late Vahidin.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: PW-2, do you know what the role or function of Vahidin was?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: He was a member of the command structure of the El Mujahed Detachment.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And do you know, sir, what his specific function was within the command structure of the El Mujahed Detachment?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: He was the commander for actions for combat.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: You told us, PW-2, that this is the late Vahidin. Do you know, sir, the circumstances and time period in which Vahidin was killed?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: He was killed on the 2nd of October, 1993.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: If I could just interrupt you at that point, sir.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Perhaps, Mr. President, it's best we go into private session for just a couple of moments.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: May the Chamber please move into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are back in open session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I would ask that we now go to page 7 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: PW-2, do you recognise this person?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: This person looks like the late Vahidin, but I wouldn't be able to tell you 100 per cent.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If we can go to page 8, please, of Exhibit 92.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: The same question, sir. Do you recognise this person?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: This person also looks like the late Vahidin, but I'm not 100 per cent sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Please go to page 9 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise the person or persons depicted in these two photographs?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: It is possible that this is Vahidin.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we go to page 10 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Let's focus first, sir, on the top photograph of page 10 of Exhibit 92. Do you recognise anyone in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I recognise the Travnik Mufti.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you know the name of the Travnik Mufti?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Nusret, and I can't recall his last name.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And, again, for the record, sir, which person in this photograph do you recognise as the Travnik Mufti? Can you describe what that person is wearing?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: His robe, and he has his head wear. That's the religious attire.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise, sir, anyone else in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we look, please, at the bottom photograph.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise anyone in that photograph?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I recognise the mufti. I had also seen this person wearing the blue beret. He was also one of the group, but I can't recall his name.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And, sir, when you say "the group," what group are you referring to?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Please repeat your question.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Sir, you said that you recall seeing the person wearing the blue beret and that he was also one of the group, and I'm asking you what group you were referring to when you said you recognised the person wearing the blue beret.

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I believe that he belonged to a local unit. He was not a member of the El Mujahed Detachment.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we please go to page 11 of Exhibit 92.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Again, let's focus on the top photograph, please. Sir, do you recognise any of the people in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I recognise the mufti again.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And, again, for the benefit of the record, can you describe what the mufti is wearing?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: His religious attire.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise anyone else in this photograph, sir?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I'm not sure. Sakib Mahmuljin could be one of them, but it's not a very clear photo, so I can't be 100 per cent sure.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: The person that you think might be Sakib Mahmuljin, which person is he in the photograph? Can you describe him in the photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: To the right, the last person on the right in the photo, but I'm not sure. It's a bad photo.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: I understand that, sir. This person that you believe might be Sakib Mahmuljin, where are his hands in the photograph?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Facing downwards.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we go to the lower photograph, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise anyone in this photograph, sir?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I recognise the late General Alic [as interpreted].

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: The transcript, sir, has captured the name "the late General Alic." Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Alagic.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And the person that you recognise as being the late General Alagic, where is he in the photograph?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: In the middle of the photo.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: In which row?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: The first row.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: What is on -- what, if anything, is on the head of the person that you've identified as the late General Alagic?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Is the person that you've recognised as the late General Alagic wearing a hat or not wearing a hat?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: No, he's not.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, page 12 of Exhibit 92.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise anyone in this photograph, sir?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Dr. Haris, the late Dr. Haris.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Which person in the photograph is the late Dr. Haris?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: He's holding a mic in his hand.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If we can go to page 13 of Exhibit 92.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Focusing your attention, sir, on the top photograph, do you recognise anyone in that photograph?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: The late Dr. Haris.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Which person in the photograph have you recognised as the late Dr. Haris?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: The one in the front of the photo, the one that you can see best at the left of the photo.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And the lower photograph on page 13 of Exhibit 92, do you recognise anyone in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Also the same person, Dr. Haris, the late Dr. Haris.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we go to page 14 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise anyone in these photographs, sir?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: In all these photos, I see the late Dr. Haris.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Which person in these photographs is the late Dr. Haris?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: The person holding a mic in his hand.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise anyone else in these photographs, sir?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: No, but I suppose that the person standing next to him is the interpreter, but I can't be sure of that because I can't see his face very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we please go to page 15 of Exhibit 92.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And while that's coming up, sir, do you know, when you say "the interpreter," do you know who was the interpreter or who served as interpreters for Dr. Haris?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: There's several men. It depended on what the requirement was. I know that for a while, it was Malik Basic, but there are other interpreters as well.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Turning to page 15 of Exhibit 92, do you recognise this person?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: This is Abu Hamza. That's what they called him. He is from Syria.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we go, please, to page 16 of Exhibit 92.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise this person, PW-2?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: This is Aiman from Syria.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Page 17 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Witness, do you recognise this person?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Abu Maali.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we go to page 18 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Abu Maali.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Page 19 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This could also be Abu Maali, but, again, this is a bad photo and I can't be really sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Page 20 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise this individual, PW-2?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we go to page 21 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This is Muatez, also deceased.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, finally, can we go to page 22 of Exhibit 92, please.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise this individual, Witness?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And the last page of this exhibit, page 23 of Exhibit 92.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Now, Witness PW-2, that's the end of that exhibit. It's already in evidence, so --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: But did we get an answer to this page 23?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: It says: "No."

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Oh: "No."

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: I take it, sir, you don't recognise this last photograph, the person depicted in that photograph.

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Now, PW-2, can you tell us how long you remained a member of the El Mujahedin Detachment after joining that unit in the summer of 1993?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I was a member of that unit until the end of the war.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Can you tell us, sir, the members of the El Mujahedin Detachment during the time period you were in that unit, where did they come from?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Well, there were a lot of foreigners from various countries, and there were also locals, Bosniaks.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I would ask that the Exhibit P01835 be pulled up, P01835.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: And while that's coming up, PW-2, you indicated there were a lot of foreigners from various countries. Can you give some examples of some of the countries that these foreign members of the El Mujahedin Unit came from?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I know that some were from Egypt; the others from Algiers; from a number of Arab countries; from several countries.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If we could please go to the next page, I'm sorry, page 2 of this document in both languages.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Just before we do that, you kept on mentioning, when you were going through the photographs, that some people came from Syria. Were those also members of the Mujahedin, the El Mujahedin?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: PW-2, do you now see a list in front of you?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Do you recognise, sir, any of the names contained on this list?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Abu Haris --

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Sorry.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] -- number 1; number 2, Abu Maali - I am familiar only with the first parts of their names. I don't know their last names - number 3, Muatez; number 10; number 21.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you, PW-2. Your Honours, we would ask that P01835 be admitted into evidence and it be given an exhibit number, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: P01835 is admitted into evidence. May it please be given an exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, that will be Exhibit 109.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I'd ask now that P02058, P02058, be shown to the witness, please, and I would ask that -- actually, we need to go to page 6 in the B/C/S version, page 10 in the English translation. I would ask that we go into private session for a few questions concerning this document, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: May the Chamber please move into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are back in open session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Yes, Mr. Mundis.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: We would ask that P02058 be admitted into evidence and it be given an exhibit number, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: May we move into private session? I'm sorry, I'm lost. Where are we?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, I'm about to assign an exhibit number to this document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be Exhibit number 110.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. That's document P02058.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone for the Presiding Judge, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Sorry. Now, we have now assigned a number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Sorry, Your Honour. That will be Exhibit number 110.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I'd ask that the witness now be shown P02761. P02761.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: PW-2, during the time that you were a member of the El Mujahedin Unit, from the summer of 1993 until the end of the war, on any occasion did that unit receive any commendations or awards?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I don't know whether the unit received anything, but some individuals in the unit did.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could we please go, in the B/C/S version of this document, to page 29. Sorry, I stand corrected. If we could go to page 2 in both the B/C/S and English versions. I apologise for that.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Sir, do you recognise any of the names contained on this page of this document, P02761?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: Number 30, Adnan Pezo; 31, Nurudin Alihodza.

utterances.speaker: THE COURT
utterances.text: Witness PW-2, these two people you just identified, Adnan Pezo and Nurudin Alihodza, how did you know them?

utterances.speaker: PW-2
utterances.text: I knew Nurudin Alihodza from the beginning of the Muslim Forces war. I was in his village on the front line during the conflict with the HVO because the front line was next to his house. And I also know Adnan Pezo. I met him when I first came back from captivity. That's when I met him.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Your Honours, I note the time. We would ask that this document be admitted into evidence and be given an exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: The document is admitted into evidence. May it please be given an exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, that will be Exhibit 111.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Mundis.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Your Honour, I note the time. It had been my intention to finish today. I believe need ten to 15 minutes tops tomorrow, if that is acceptable, to complete the direct examination.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The Court will adjourn until tomorrow at 9.00 in the morning in this same courtroom, Courtroom I. Thank you very much. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
